outcome: Number of cysts in eye and brain
Accumulation of inflammatory cells in placenta
cohort: Pregnant BALB/c mice exposed to T. gondii on the twelfth day of gestation.
finding: Both clindamycin and spiramycin treatments significantly reduced the number of T. gondii cysts in the eye and brain, suppressed inflammatory changes, and improved placental and retinal pathology in infected pregnant mice.
gest_age: Exposure on the twelfth day of gestation
